descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-20 ER; TFA-92598 How it works 1, AC 3 · “Counts accurately match real patient list state”.

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S08 Pending → In Progress through real chart actions (Save Note, Save & Extract), both care settings

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently (TFA-92598 How it works 1; TFA-92598 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U8 Each Save Note and Generate run in TC-20 logs the AI call time (aiCallLog.providerMs) separately from the total (durationMs). Save Note targets 15 s or less in 9/10 runs. … (UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture; both patients pending

When Hospital: open the dashboard, open the patient, type pre-round text and tap Save Note, return to the dashboard; open Encounter, type text and tap Save & Extract, return to the dashboard. Nursing Home: open the dashboard, type pre-round text in the resident's chart, tap Save Note, return to the dashboard

Then Each dashboard visit reflects the chart's real state with no page reload: Pending 1 → In Progress 1 after Save Note, still In Progress 1 after Save & Extract, Total always 1. Each Save Note and Save & Extract time is recorded

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Ticket rule 1 (pre-round done = no longer 'not yet prepped'). Counts per checkpoint as listed; every checkpoint mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' and the patient. This is SPA navigation, not 'while open'; the live case is S09. U8: record the total time of each Save Note and Save & Extract and the aiCallLog providerMs (S17 reads them; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
